Package index

Geocoding

Resolve free-text Canadian addresses to coordinates, interpolating the civic numbers NAR does not carry.

geocode()
Geocode Canadian addresses to coordinates

Address normalization

Parse free-text Canadian addresses into the components NAR is keyed on, sort them by the shape they parsed as, and put them back together as a match key or a readable line. Useful on its own for matching and deduplicating address lists, not only as a step towards a coordinate.

normalize_address()
Normalize Canadian address strings into NAR components
address_pattern()
Sort Canadian address strings into structural buckets
address_key()
Build a match key from parsed address components
format_address()
Render parsed address components back into one line

External geocoders

The Province of British Columbia’s Address Geocoder, as a fallback for BC addresses NAR cannot place and as an independent source to validate against. Makes network requests.

bc_geocode()
Geocode British Columbia addresses with the BC Address Geocoder
bc_validate()
Check NAR geocoding results against the BC Address Geocoder

Reverse geocoding

Find the addresses nearest a coordinate.

reverse_geocode()
Reverse Geocode Coordinates to Address

The NAR database

Download and open a National Address Repository release, and get query results back as sf.

nar_connection()
Get NAR data
available_nar_versions()
Scrape availabe NAR versions from the StatCan website
collect_nar()
Collect a NAR table as an sf object
